_meta.description: Starter .ase-project.json config for a Next.js 15 project. Copy this to your project root and customize.

name: my-nextjs-app
description: A full-stack Next.js application with PostgreSQL backend.
conventions: All components use named exports, never default exports
API routes use Next.js Route Handlers in /app/api/**/*.ts
Zod schemas for all external input validation
Error boundaries at the feature root level
architecture_patterns: Server Components for data fetching, Client Components for interactivity only
never_do: Never use useEffect for data fetching — use React Server Components or SWR
Never store secrets in .env files committed to git
Never use inline styles — always use Tailwind classes
Never use `any` TypeScript type — always type explicitly
Never mix database access logic into components
preferred_patterns: Use Zod for all schema validation
Use Drizzle ORM for all database access
Use Next.js Image component for all images
